criteria.text: States that the escrow release date is 28 May 2028 (24 months after the 28 May 2026 Closing Date) and that pending claims must be notified before then.
Identifies that the 4-year SPA non-compete may be unenforceable as wider than reasonably necessary and is inconsistent with the 12-month restriction in the Founder's employment agreement.

Identifies the conflict between the 30-day claim notice period in SPA Section 9.7 and the 60-day period in Escrow Clause 5.2, and recommends the Buyer works to the shorter 30-day period or aligns the documents.
Identifies that the warranty cap in SPA Section 8.4 is stated as $39,600,000 but 20% of the $220,000,000 Purchase Price is $44,000,000, i.e. the stated figure is wrong.

Identifies that the board approval was given at a meeting with only 2 directors present when Article 11 requires a quorum of three, so the approval may be invalid, and recommends a fresh or ratifying resolution.
Lists valid board approval of the transaction as a required approval and states it has not been validly obtained.
Shows the arithmetic for the cap (20% x $220,000,000 = $44,000,000) and flags the discrepancy with the stated $39,600,000.
Assigns a risk rating (High / Medium / Low) to each issue.
